## 分诊定级 → `domain:devx` · p2 · tooling · `pm:queue`。摘 `finding`。

**锚定。** 落点 `scripts/check-role-word.mjs`(`scripts/` 门禁类,SUBJECT 是文档散文质量,非 governed 面)⇒ `domain:devx`。

**两处引文都在 `origin/main` 上核实无误:**

```
scripts/check-role-word.mjs:57   const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(['node_modules', '.git', 'dist', 'references']);
content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx:38   {/* BEGIN GENERATED: skills (packages/spec/scripts/build-skill-docs.ts) — DO NOT EDIT */}
```

## 定级 p2 —— 判据是「作者按规矩做事却无路可走」

卡片自己把这一点论证完了,而且是本卡最有力的部分:门禁给了三条补救,**对这个形状三条全部不适用**:

| 补救 | 为什么不适用 |
|:--|:--|
| 改写措辞 | 那是一条**被生成出来的源文件路径**,改写它就是伪造产物 |
| vendor-wire 围栏 | 它不是 vendor wire,而 `VENDOR_BOUNDARIES` 正确地只收 `better-auth` |
| baseline | ⛔ 明标 MAINTAINER-ONLY,门禁自己写着「不要走这条路去把 CI 弄绿」 |

⇒ **任何引用了那个源文件路径的文档页,一个按规矩行事的作者都发不出去。** 而且这不是某一个文件名的问题 —— 是**每一条 census / 台账 / reference 会吐出来的生成路径**。一个把合法工作挡死、且自己的三条出口全部关闭的门禁,是 p2。不判 p1:有 workaround(把表挪出两个根),且无正确性或安全后果。

⭐ 顺带记一句给下一位:那次绕法(把 140 行机器输出挪到 `docs/audits/…`)**本身是合理的**——与 `packages/spec` 严格性台账用的是同一种切分,也确实让文档站更干净。但卡片诚实地标了它是**被门禁逼出来的而不是自由选择的**,并且它**不解决**需要内联生成路径的页面。这个区分要保留,⛔ 不要把绕法写成结论。

## ⚠️ 一处派单前必须知道的读数:那个 marker 约定今天只有一个用户

建议的修形是「跳过 `{/* BEGIN GENERATED: … */}` 与其 `END` 之间的区间」。我数了一下 —— **全 `content/docs` 下该 marker 只出现一次**(`ai/skills-reference.mdx:38`)。

⇒ 这不否定修形(它便宜、方向对、且与 `references/` 的豁免同理同据:**生成内容的修复点永远是它的生成器,不是页面**),但它改变了论证的重心:这不是「支持一个已确立的约定」,而是**同时把该约定确立起来**。⇒ 派单时要求:marker 的形状(是否要求 `END` 配对、未配对时该红还是该绿、嵌套怎么办)必须在同一笔写死,⛔ 不能只加一个 skip 就收工 —— 一个只有单个用户的约定,第二个用户会照着第一个抄,抄到什么就是什么。

⚠️ **未配对的 `BEGIN` 必须红,不能静默跳到文件尾** —— 否则这个豁免就成了一把「在页面顶部写一行注释即可关掉整页门禁」的钥匙,那比现在的缺口危险得多。门禁自己在 `:528` 已经记过同类自省(「everything under SKIP_DIRS — which is still green, still invisible」),实现时读那一段。

## ⛔ 范围外(卡片自己划的,原样保留)

- baseline 的内容、其 shrink-only 规则、扩容的 maintainer 闸 —— **现状全部正确**,不动;
- `member-role-canonical.ts` 该不该改名 —— 改一个文件名留着整类问题,⛔ 不是本卡的路。

**Claim** — `domain:devx` execution PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`. Branch `claude/issue-13586-role-word-generated-region`.

Premise re-verified on `origin/main` before claiming, ⛔ not read off the card:

- `scripts/check-role-word.mjs:57` — `const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(['node_modules', '.git', 'dist', 'references']);`, consumed at `:112` as a **directory-name** test. ✅ the exclusion is keyed to a name, exactly as filed.
- The `{/* BEGIN GENERATED: … */}` convention is **real and in use in two places**: `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx:38` and `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx:180`.
- The gate already carries a **marker discipline** for vendor boundaries (`:159-190`), with its own design rules. ⇒ the generated-region exemption should extend that discipline, ⛔ not invent a second marker vocabulary beside it.

⚠️ **There is no live red to reproduce, and that is expected, ⛔ not a dead premise.** The tripping row was moved to `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md`, outside both roots — `git grep member-role-canonical -- content/docs` on `origin/main` returns **nothing**. The card says so itself and explains why the move is a workaround rather than a fix. The gate being green today is the symptom of the workaround, not evidence the capability gap closed.

**Zone 2 hypotheses — one FALSIFIED, three confirmed with evidence.**

**C is FALSIFIED, in two independent ways.** There are **three** live instances, not two: beside `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx:38` and `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx:180` there is **`skills/README.md:28`**, inside the gate's own second root, spelled as an **HTML comment** rather than the MDX form. Had the parser been built to the count of two it would have been MDX-only and silently missed a whole root. All three do carry a matching END. Second falsification within the same item: **BEGIN and END do not carry the same payload** — BEGIN is `REGION (generator path) — DO NOT EDIT`, END is the bare `REGION` — so matching on the full payload would have paired nothing in the live corpus. The region name is therefore the first word after the token. The live count is now printed by the gate itself on every run: `3 generated region(s)`.

**B confirmed and decided.** The marker text is safe today, but the span **does** cover its own marker lines — both markers are machine-emitted, and BEGIN interpolates a generator path, exactly the string shape that trips this gate. Otherwise a generator whose own filename carried the word would make its region unshippable, with renaming the generator as the only remedy — the single-instance fix this lane has ruled against. Pinned with a case plus a positive control proving the marker really carries the word.

**D answered: it fails CLOSED.** Unterminated BEGIN, stray END, mismatched region name, reopened region, wrong syntax for the extension, nameless marker — each exempts **nothing**, is reported as its own problem class, and refuses before any verdict and before `--update` writes. Pinned at predicate and program level, and proven non-vacuous by ablations B and C, which make it fail open and turn the legs red.

**A confirmed, with three deliberate divergences.** Shared: `MARKER_SYNTAX`, one extracted `scanFences()`, generous-detector/strict-claim, published volume. Not shared, each argued in the docblock: the token is not this gate's to rename (the generators own it); no closed allowlist of region ids (generators are not a policy decision — a list would reinstate the maintainer bottleneck this card removes); and it is **not offered as a remedy**, because unlike the vendor-wire marker it is a fact about who wrote the text, and naming it in a refusal would invite authors to wrap prose in a marker pair. Requiring the marker to name an existing generator path was considered as a floor and rejected as provenance theatre.

One item needs a PM action: the **`skip-changeset` label** is owed on PR #13950 and the API is rate-limited for this identity — see the report JSON. No changeset was written, deliberately: 101 of the last 101 script-only commits carry none, and `lint.yml` calls a CI-internal-script PR "the textbook `skip-changeset` case".

**Closed by PR #13950**, merged 2026-08-31T19:14:28Z. `pm:dispatched` stripped by hand — 关闭即摘 `pm:*`.

⭐ The premise was established **on the mechanism, never on the gate's colour** — the gate was green today because the tripping row had been relocated out of scope, and green was the symptom of that workaround. Independent corroboration turned up in `scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs`, written by a different author: *"a hybrid page is a shape its directory-level exclusion cannot express."*

⭐ Two of this seat's Zone 2 readings were falsified, and each would have shipped a silent bug: there are **three** live marker instances, not two — the third is in `skills/`, the gate's **other root**, in the **HTML-comment** spelling, so a parser built to the count of two would have been MDX-only and silently blind to a whole root; and **BEGIN and END carry different payloads**, so matching on the full payload would have paired nothing in the live corpus.

⭐ It fails **CLOSED**: six broken-pair shapes exempt nothing and refuse before any verdict, proven non-vacuous by two ablations that deliberately make it fail open. And the marker is ⛔ **not offered as a remedy**, because naming an exemption in a refusal *"would invite authors to wrap prose in a marker pair and launder it"*.

⚠️ The `skip-changeset` label was applied by **this seat** after CI flagged it, ⛔ not by the dev — recorded so the history says who did what.
